annotations.title: Audit Revised Section 508, WCAG 2.2 AA & Generate VPAT 2.5 Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR)

description: Audit software, cloud SaaS portals, and electronic deliverables against Revised Section 508 (36 CFR Part 1194 / FAR Subpart 39.2), W3C WCAG 2.1 / 2.2 Level A & AA Success Criteria, and State SLED digital accessibility laws (such as Colorado HB21-1110) to generate an Accessibility Readiness Score (0-100), a structured ITI VPAT 2.5 Conformance Matrix (WCAG 2.2 Level A/AA + Revised Section 508 Chapters 3, 5, and 6), an Engineering Accessibility Remediation POA&M Roadmap, and a paste-ready VPAT 2.5 ACR & Equally Effective Alternate Access Plan (EEAAP) proposal narrative. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive accessibility compliance generator (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `product_architecture_and_ui_specs` accepts 20 to 45,000 characters and `known_accessibility_test_results_or_gaps` accepts 10 to 35,000 characters). Use this tool when auditing software/SaaS accessibility or generating a Section 508 VPAT 2.5 ACR table for federal/SLED proposals; use `answer_security_questionnaire` instead for cybersecurity/SOC 2/NIST 800-171 questionnaires, or `scan_far_dfars_clauses` for general Section I FAR/DFARS clause flow-down audits.

known_accessibility_test_results_or_gaps.default: Automated axe-core/WAVE CI scan + manual NVDA/JAWS screen-reader and keyboard-only navigation baseline.
known_accessibility_test_results_or_gaps.description: Known accessibility test findings (axe-core, Lighthouse, DHS Trusted Tester v5, JAWS/NVDA/VoiceOver), existing exceptions (e.g., third-party GIS map canvas or legacy PDF exports), and current remediation status (10 to 35,000 characters).

product_architecture_and_ui_specs.description: Description of the software/SaaS application, UI framework (React/Angular/USWDS), electronic documents, user workflows, and target RFP Section 508 / accessibility solicitation clauses (20 to 45,000 characters).

name: audit_section_508_vpat

accessibility_readiness_score.description: 0-100 score quantifying the product's Section 508 / WCAG 2.2 AA compliance readiness and VPAT 2.5 defensibility.

engineering_remediation_roadmap.description: Prioritized Accessibility Plan of Action & Milestones (POA&M) and engineering remediation roadmap.

executive_vpat_summary.description: Executive accessibility compliance summary for the Agency Section 508 Coordinator and Contracting Officer.

overall_section_508_determination.description: Overall Section 508 / WCAG 2.2 AA procurement conformance determination under FAR 39.2 and ITI VPAT 2.5 standards.

ready_to_submit_vpat_2_5_acr_narrative.description: Complete, paste-ready ITI VPAT 2.5 Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR) & FAR 39.2 Proposal Volume narrative including EEAAP.

vpat_2_5_conformance_matrix.description: Structured ITI VPAT 2.5 Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR) audit rows covering WCAG 2.2 Level A/AA and Revised Section 508 Chapters 3, 5, and 6.
